title: SHARECHAT: A Dataset of Chatbot Conversations in the Wild

bias_targets.methodology: Using the pre-trained Detoxify multi-label classification model to compute mean probability scores for identity attacks across different chatbot platforms in both user messages and LLM responses.
Analyzing the frequency distribution and concentration of external domain sources (e.g., social media vs. encyclopedic sites) cited by search-enabled models to evaluate risks of information bias.
